title: SanntiS 1.2.1: data and analyses
description:
Runbooks that reproduce the data, models and analyses behind SanntiS 1.2.1 (objectives 00-03: data collection; production models, negative pool v2 and the SanntiS model bundle; MIBiG 3.1 validation on the v3 test sets; tool comparison), with the expected results each runbook is checked against.

The data the runbooks produce are archived in separate Zenodo records (versions in env/zenodo.tsv): training archives (10.5281/zenodo.23998436), test sets (10.5281/zenodo.23998763), MIBiG 3.1 evaluation (10.5281/zenodo.23998765) and the SanntiS model bundle (10.5281/zenodo.23998767).
